1.name: Fully Automatic High-Precision Lamination Machine
1.summary: Designed specifically for glass and display modules. Lamination accuracy refined to ±0.075mm, equipped with constant pressure control, cycle time as fast as 80 seconds.
1.contentHtml:
The fully automatic high-precision laminating machine is a high-end intelligent equipment independently developed by TXAM, specifically designed for high-precision lamination of glass and display modules.

Working Principle

The equipment adopts a precision mechanical structure combined with an advanced motion control system to achieve automatic feeding, precise positioning, high-precision lamination, and pressure holding. The entire process is automatically controlled to ensure lamination accuracy and consistent quality.

Technical Advantages

  • Lamination accuracy reaches ±0.075mm, far exceeding industry standards
  • Constant pressure function ensures firm lamination without bubbles
  • 80-second ultra-fast cycle time, greatly improving production efficiency
  • Supports multiple product sizes with high flexibility

Application Fields

Widely used in glass lamination processes for electronic products such as televisions, educational displays, and commercial display screens.

2.name: OC Intelligent Lamination System
2.summary: Fully automatic precision assembly of Open Cell and backlight modules. Utilizes UVW vision alignment platform to completely solve the screen cracking issue caused by manual lamination.
2.contentHtml:
The OC intelligent lamination system is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for the core processes of display panel production.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a UVW vision alignment platform to automatically identify product positions and guide robots to complete precision OC and backlight module assembly. The fully automated process includes automatic loading, foam collection, and empty box collection.

Technical Advantages

  • Lamination accuracy reaches ±0.15mm to ±0.4mm
  • Fixed cycle time of 25 seconds ensures production rhythm
  • Completely solves the screen cracking issue caused by manual lamination
  • One-click product changeover reduces model switching time

Model Description

The TXM-A series includes models such as 151B, 201B, and 401B, with the main differences being compatible product sizes and lamination accuracy.

4.name: High-Precision Robotic Dispensing Machine
4.summary: Single-axis robot with multi-glue-gun matrix, positioning error ±0.2mm, single-line dispensing takes only 0.25 seconds. CAD drawings import seamlessly, one-click changeover.
4.contentHtml:
The high-precision robotic dispensing machine is a core piece of equipment developed by TXAM for precision coating processes.

Working Principle

It utilizes a single-axis robot combined with a multi-nozzle matrix, achieving fast and uniform dispensing through a precision motion control system. It supports direct import of CAD drawings and automatic generation of dispensing paths.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning error of only ±0.2mm, industry-leading precision
  • Dispensing speed of 0.25 seconds per line, extremely high efficiency
  • Supports one-click CAD drawing import for convenient changeovers
  • TCP/IP communication protocol, easy integration into smart factory systems

Model Description

The TX-NS-AGD-01 uses a fixture tray format, while the TX-NS-AGD-02 uses direct backplane feeding; the main difference lies in the production line compatibility method.

5.name: Automatic Adhesive Sprayer
5.summary: Evenly sprays glue onto target objects, suitable for larger-sized panels. High spraying efficiency and strong compatibility, from 75" to full-size panels.
5.contentHtml:
The automatic glue spraying machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for large-panel glue spraying needs.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a glue block melting furnace feeding method, heating and melting solid glue blocks, which are then evenly coated onto the product surface through a spray nozzle. The spraying speed is fast, and the coating is uniform.

Technical Advantages

  • Spraying speed of 0.6-0.8m/s, leading industry efficiency
  • Compatible with sizes from 75" to full size, wide application range
  • Multiple models available: TX-NS-ASM-01/02/03
  • Can be combined with vision or mechanical positioning

6.name: Automatic Light Diffuser Bracket Placing Machine
6.summary: Precisely picks and places diffusion support brackets, providing stable support for display device optical components. Accurate positioning and high-speed picking.
6.contentHtml:
The automatic lamp holder placement machine is used to precisely place diffuser bracket posts during the product assembly process.

Working Principle

The equipment automatically feeds materials through a vibratory bowl feeder, and the robot precisely grips the bracket posts and places them at designated positions. Positioning accuracy reaches ±0.2mm, with a gripping speed of 1 second per piece.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning accuracy of ±0.2mm ensures assembly precision
  • High-speed gripping, completing thousands per hour
  • Vibratory bowl automatic feeding reduces manual intervention
  • Multiple models TX-NS-ALPS-01/02/03 to accommodate different sizes and production requirements

7.name: Automatic LED Strip Placing Machine
7.summary: Precisely and quickly place LED light strips at designated positions. Capable of picking up multiple strips at once, with pressure-holding function to ensure assembly accuracy.
7.contentHtml:
The automatic light bar placement machine uses a robotic unit to automate the placement of light bars.

Working Principle

Using a robot combined with a vision system, it can precisely grasp 7 light bars and place them at the target position at once. The equipment features a pressure-holding function to ensure the light bars are firmly secured.

Technical Advantages

  • Assembly precision ±0.2mm
  • Can grasp 7 light bars at once for high efficiency
  • Pressure-holding function ensures assembly quality
  • Supports CAD import for quick changeovers

8.name: Robotic Automatic Back Panel Screwing Machine
8.summary: Capable of picking up and automatically tightening up to 12 backplate screws at once, with real-time adjustable torque per screw and an efficiency of up to 1.8 seconds per screw.
8.contentHtml:
The robot automatic backplane screw driving machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for precision fastening processes.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a robot combined with an intelligent fastening system, capable of picking up 12 screws at once and automatically fastening them onto the product. Torque is adjustable in real time, ensuring consistent fastening torque for each screw.

Technical Advantages

  • Can pick up 12 screws at once, reducing feeding frequency
  • Fastening speed of 1.8 seconds per screw, extremely efficient
  • Real-time adjustable torque ensures fastening quality
  • Suitable for backplane fastening of TVs, educational displays, and more

9.name: 180° Heavy-Duty Flipper
9.summary: Designed for flipping large or heavy products, achieving precise 180-degree rotation. It solves issues such as difficulty in manual flipping caused by process requirements.
9.contentHtml:
The 180-degree heavy-duty turnover machine is a core device developed by TXAM to meet the flipping needs of large and heavy products.

Working Principle

The equipment adopts a precision mechanical structure combined with a servo drive system to achieve one-click 180-degree flipping. The flipping process is smooth with precise positioning, effectively solving the difficulties and safety hazards of manual flipping.

Technical Advantages

  • Flipping cycle of 15-55 seconds, high efficiency
  • One-click operation, simple and convenient
  • Strong load capacity, suitable for large products such as TVs and educational displays
  • Multiple models available: TXM-B-105 series (A/B/C) and 205A

10.name: Automatic Tempered Glass Bezel Installation Machine
10.summary: Automatically installs tempered glass frames for educational displays. Uses vision positioning with accuracy up to ±0.15mm.
10.contentHtml:
The automatic tempered glass frame installation machine is an automated assembly unit developed by TXAM for educational display products.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a CCD vision system to automatically identify product positions and guides the robot to complete precise tempered glass frame installation. The positioning accuracy is as high as ±0.15mm.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning accuracy of ±0.15mm, leading the industry
  • Vision-based positioning for strong adaptability
  • TX-NS-ACTGR-02 model offers faster cycle times
  • Specifically designed for educational display products

11.name: 6-Axis Robot Intelligent Palletizing System
11.summary: Perfectly solves the challenge of heavy-duty finished product palletizing. Supports simulated machine palletizing and mother-daughter pallets, with precision controlled within ±0.5mm and speeds up to 12 seconds per piece.
11.contentHtml:
The six-axis robot intelligent palletizing system is a core equipment developed by TXAM for automated logistics at the end of the production line.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a six-axis industrial robot (optional ABB, Yaskawa, etc.), combined with an intelligent control system to achieve automatic product palletizing. It supports simulated machine palletizing and mother-daughter pallets, with extremely strong compatibility.

Technical Advantages

  • Palletizing accuracy of ±0.5mm, neat and stable stacking
  • Efficiency up to 12 seconds per piece
  • Supports simulated machine palletizing and mother-daughter pallets
  • Compatible with products of different sizes and shapes

Model Description

TX-NS-PR series (01/02/03) and integrated palletizing TX-NS-RIP-001, the latter being more powerful, including mother-daughter pallet stacking, automatic pad placement, scanning, etc.

12.name: End-of-Line Upright Packaging & Automatic Case Packing System
12.summary: Integrated automatic pallet stacking (skid), unboxing, forming, and full machine packing. Fully compatible with mechanical rigid positioning, completing single skid centering in 20 seconds.
12.contentHtml:
The end-of-line automatic case packing system is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for the post-packaging process.

Working Principle

The equipment integrates an automatic palletizer, case unpacker, case former, and case packer to achieve full automation of the post-production packaging process. One-touch operation automatically completes pallet stacking and centering.

Technical Advantages

  • Pallet centering cycle time is only 20 seconds per unit
  • Mechanical rigid positioning for greater compatibility
  • Allows a certain range of pallet offset
  • Multiple models available: TX-NS-AET-01/02/03

13.name: Integrated Robotic Palletizing Solution
13.summary: A more powerful integrated palletizing solution, featuring special functions such as child-mother pallet stacking, automatic slip sheet placement, and scanning.
13.contentHtml:
The robot integrated palletizing solution is a full-featured palletizing system developed by TXAM for high-end customers.

Working Principle

Based on standard palletizing functions, it integrates sub-mother pallet stacking, automatic slip sheet placement, and scanning functions to achieve full automation of the post-production logistics process.

Technical Advantages

  • Complete functionality covering the entire post-production logistics process
  • Sub-mother pallet stacking function, suitable for more scenarios
  • Automatic slip sheet placement, reducing manual intervention
  • Scanning function for traceable logistics information

14.name: Robotic Uprighting Unit
14.summary: Automatically converts products from horizontal to vertical orientation. Uses CCD vision to determine product position, and robots automatically pick and place to complete the vertical action.
14.contentHtml:
The robotic verticalization unit is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for product posture conversion.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a CCD vision system to automatically determine product position, guiding a six-axis robot to pick up the product and complete the posture conversion from horizontal to vertical. The verticalization process is smooth, effectively protecting product safety.

Technical Advantages

  • CCD vision guidance for accurate positioning
  • Smooth verticalization process to avoid product damage
  • Significantly reduces labor and improves efficiency
  • Customizable according to different product characteristics

15.name: Auxiliary Vision Inspection Unit
15.summary: Through automatic flipping and image recognition, it assists or replaces manual inspection of product appearance quality, solving the difficulty of manually flipping heavy products.
15.contentHtml:
The auxiliary visual inspection unit is an automated auxiliary device developed by TXAM for product quality inspection.

Working Principle

The equipment automatically flips products and works with the image recognition system to assist in completing product appearance quality inspection. It effectively solves the difficulty of manually flipping heavy products.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic flipping function, solving the difficulty of flipping heavy products
  • Works with vision systems to improve inspection accuracy
  • Significantly enhances appearance inspection efficiency
  • Reduces employee labor intensity

16.name: Automatic Pressure Holding Unit
16.summary: Apply and maintain constant pressure on assembled components to ensure bonding or assembly process quality. Precise pressure control with extended pressure-holding duration.
16.contentHtml:
The automatic pressure-holding unit is an automated device developed by TXAM for bonding processes.

Working Principle

The equipment applies constant pressure to products that have completed processes such as dispensing and lamination, ensuring the adhesive is fully cured and assembly quality remains stable and consistent.

Technical Advantages

  • Precise pressure control, ensuring bonding quality
  • Long pressure-holding time, adapting to different process requirements
  • High adaptability, compatible with a variety of products
  • Automated operation, reducing manual intervention

18.name: Rotary Table
18.summary: Precision rotary equipment for multi-station processing or inspection of products, enabling multi-angle automated handling.
18.contentHtml:
The rotary table is an automated unit equipment developed by TXAM for multi-station processing needs.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision servo drive system to achieve multi-angle rotation and positioning of products. Combined with an automated loading and unloading system, it can complete processes such as multi-station machining, inspection, and assembly.

Technical Advantages

  • Precise positioning with high repeatability
  • Multi-station design improves production efficiency
  • High level of automation reduces manual intervention
  • Strong adaptability, compatible with a variety of products

19.name: Lifting Unit
19.summary: Lifting and conveying equipment used to transfer products between workstations at different heights, enabling seamless integration of production lines.
19.contentHtml:
The lifting unit is an automated conveying equipment developed by TXAM for seamless integration of production lines.

Working Principle

The equipment adopts a servo drive system, combined with precision guide rails to achieve smooth lifting and lowering of products. It is suitable for product transfer between workstations at different heights, enabling seamless connection of the production line.

Technical Advantages

  • Smooth lifting and lowering with strong load capacity
  • Automated control, perfectly coordinated with the production line
  • Stable structure with long service life
  • Customizable stroke and load

20.name: Module Transfer Machine
20.summary: Precision equipment for automatic transfer of electronic modules between different workstations, supporting multiple product sizes.
20.contentHtml:
The module transfer machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for the transfer of electronic modules.

Working Principle

The equipment adopts a precision motion control system to achieve accurate transfer of modules between multiple stations. Combined with a vision positioning system, it can adapt to the precise transfer of products of different sizes.

Technical Advantages

  • High transfer accuracy and precise product positioning
  • Supports multi-station configuration with high flexibility
  • High level of automation, reducing manual intervention
  • Easy changeover, adaptable to multi-variety production

21.name: Automatic Clip & Buckle Assembler
21.summary: Automated equipment for automatic installation of clips or wrenches, with precise positioning for quick snap-fit assembly.
21.contentHtml:
The automatic clip trigger is an automated device developed by TXAM for clip assembly.

Working Principle

The equipment uses precision mechanical structures combined with servo drives to achieve automatic gripping, positioning, and installation of clips or triggers. It is equipped with a visual inspection system to ensure assembly quality.

Technical Advantages

  • Automated clip assembly with high efficiency
  • Precision positioning for high assembly accuracy
  • Equipped with visual inspection for guaranteed quality
  • Adaptable to multiple product sizes

22.name: Auxiliary Bag Sealing Machine
22.summary: Automated sealing equipment for product packaging bags, utilizing heat sealing technology for aesthetically pleasing and secure seals.
22.contentHtml:
The auxiliary bag sealing machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for the packaging and sealing process.

Working Principle

The equipment uses heat sealing technology to automatically seal product packaging bags. Combined with an automatic feeding system, it achieves full automation of the sealing process.

Technical Advantages

  • Heat sealing technology, producing neat and strong seals
  • High level of automation and efficiency
  • Stable quality control, consistent sealing results
  • Easy operation and low maintenance costs

23.name: Robotic End-of-line Bagging
23.summary: Works with robots to automatically complete the bagging process after product offloading, achieving full automation of downstream packaging.
23.contentHtml:
The robotic off-line bagging machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for the post-packaging process.

Working Principle

The equipment works with a six-axis robot to automatically pick up packaging bags and place them over products, enabling automated bagging for off-line products.

Technical Advantages

  • Robotic automation ensures high efficiency
  • Precise bagging position for better product protection
  • High level of automation reduces manual labor
  • Adapts to various product sizes

24.name: Robotic Automatic Backplate Feeder
24.summary: Automated equipment for automatically placing backplanes into product assembly stations, working in coordination with robots to complete precision assembly.
24.contentHtml:
The robotic automatic backplane placement machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for the backplane placement process.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a robot combined with a precision positioning system to automatically pick up and place backplanes onto the product assembly station. It works in coordination with assembly robots to achieve fully automated backplane installation.

Technical Advantages

  • Robotic automated placement for high efficiency
  • Precise positioning ensures assembly accuracy
  • High level of automation reduces manual intervention
  • Stable quality control for consistent product output

25.name: Packaging & Logistics Automation Equipment
25.summary: Logistics automation system integration solutions covering the entire process of post-production packaging, conveying, and sorting.
25.contentHtml:
Packaging and logistics automation equipment is a system integration solution developed by TXAM for downstream logistics.

System Composition

The system covers automatic packaging equipment, conveyor lines, sorting equipment, and warehouse management systems, achieving full automation of the downstream logistics process on the production line.

Technical Advantages

  • System integration for full automation of the logistics process
  • Efficient sorting to improve logistics efficiency
  • Intelligent management with digital transparency
  • Customizable according to customer requirements

26.name: Robotic Unit Equipment
26.summary: Modular unit equipment centered around robots, flexibly configurable and integrable according to process requirements.
26.contentHtml:
Robot cell equipment is modular automation equipment developed by TXAM for flexible production.

Working Principle

The equipment is centered around a six-axis robot, paired with various end-of-arm tools and auxiliary devices to form a modular cell. It can be flexibly configured according to different process requirements, enabling multi-purpose use of a single machine.

Technical Advantages

  • Modular design, flexible configuration
  • Multi-purpose use, improving equipment utilization
  • Easy integration into existing production lines
  • Efficient and reliable, easy maintenance

27.name: Auxiliary Infeed Flipping Unit
27.summary: Auxiliary flipping device for product loading stations, working with the main equipment to achieve automated loading and unloading.
27.contentHtml:
The auxiliary loading turnover unit is an auxiliary turnover device developed by TXAM for production line loading stations.

Working Principle

The equipment works in conjunction with the main production line to achieve automatic turnover and positioning of products at the loading station, preparing for the next process.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic turnover improves loading efficiency
  • Efficient coordination with main equipment
  • Quality assurance reduces product damage
  • Easy operation and low maintenance costs

28.name: Auxiliary Outfeed Flipping Unit
28.summary: Auxiliary flipping equipment for product offloading stations, working with the main equipment to achieve automated unloading.
28.contentHtml:
The auxiliary off-line flipping unit is an auxiliary flipping device developed by TXAM for the off-line workstation of the production line.

Working Principle

The equipment works in conjunction with the main production line to achieve automatic flipping and collection of products at the off-line workstation, preparing them for downstream packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic flipping improves off-line efficiency
  • Efficient coordination with main equipment
  • Quality assurance, reducing product damage
  • Easy operation and low maintenance costs

29.name: Operator-Assisted Bagging
29.summary: Manual-assisted bagging equipment, working with automated machinery to complete product bagging and packaging.
29.contentHtml:
The manual-assisted bagging machine is an auxiliary equipment developed by TXAM for the bagging packaging process.

Working Principle

The equipment works in conjunction with manual operation to achieve semi-automated bagging packaging, improving packaging efficiency while reducing equipment investment.

Technical Advantages

  • Combination of manual and automated operation, flexible and efficient
  • Guaranteed bagging quality
  • Reduced equipment investment costs
  • Easy operation with low training costs

30.name: Robotic Automatic Overhead Conveyor Loading
30.summary: Automated equipment that works with robots to automatically mount products onto an overhead conveyor chain.
30.contentHtml:
The robot automatic hanging chain machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for overhead conveying.

Working Principle

The equipment works with a six-axis robot to automatically pick up products and mount them onto the overhead conveyor chain, enabling automatic product loading for overhead conveying.

Technical Advantages

  • Robotic automatic loading, high efficiency
  • Overhead conveying, saves floor space
  • High level of automation, reduces labor
  • Perfect integration with production lines
